evaluation_metrics.technical_timing_primary: Paired daily return difference with Newey-West HAC standard errors (lag 10), two-tailed p < 0.05
evaluation_metrics.fundamental_selection_primary: NDCG@20% and top-quintile 126-session forward excess return over KSE-100

risk_limits.action_on_breach: Halt new entries for formal audit and model review.

prohibited_practices: Never claim predictive success from small samples (N < 60).
Never assert arbitrary fixed accuracy targets (e.g. 80-90%) on noisy financial asset returns.
Never overwrite historical predictions upon receipt of financial statement restatements.
Never evaluate trade outcomes before the exact target horizon has matured.
